WITH grouped AS (
  SELECT o.timespan,
         AVG(CASE WHEN f.rebrate IS NOT NULL AND f.feerate IS NOT NULL AND f.feerate != 0 THEN f.rebrate / f.feerate END) AS avg_ratio,
         COUNT(*) AS match_count
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.timespan
),
threshold AS (
  SELECT AVG(match_count) AS avg_match_count
  FROM grouped
)
SELECT AVG(g.avg_ratio) AS average_of_average_ratios,
       SUM(g.match_count) AS total_match_count,
       AVG(g.match_count - t.avg_match_count) AS average_excess_match_count
FROM grouped AS g
CROSS JOIN threshold AS t
WHERE g.match_count > t.avg_match_count;
